newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bonds premium to be lower - RBA.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bonds premium to be lower - RBA.

text.p: The premium paid on Australian debt is expected to be lower over the years ahead, retiring Reserve Bank governor Bernie Fraser said.
"...to the extent that sound policies are followed, we can expect the premium paid on borrowed funds to be rather lower over the years ahead," Fraser told a BZW conference in Tokyo.

"The progress being made in this regard is reflected in the narrowing of interest rate spreads...The spread on 10-year bond yields relative to the United States, for example, has narrowed from around 250 basis points a year ago to around half that margin today," he said in what is seen as his last speech.
Fraser noted that 10-year bond yields had declined from about 14.0 percent to around 8.0 percent today over the past 10-years.

"We have a very different economy in Australia today compared with a decade, or even five years ago. In particular, we have lower inflation and a medium-term policy framework to keep inflation low," he said.
"This suggests that there will be further gains for those investors willing to show confidence in that framework," he added.
